registration.method: One global 15 m per WoWS viewer unit registration, following the established viewer conversion used in the Bismarck reference workflow. Game source Y=0 retained as an unverified load datum; no component fit or nonuniform scale.

limitations: Optional empty components are recorded in files.
Hull and superstructure may be fused in the reference chunks. Hull-only close-ups use camera framing; no geometry-derived sections or shape measurements are exported.
